summary: The handler now shows its fixed failure texts in the chat language: a German chat gets `KI-Anfrage fehlgeschlagen` instead of `AI request failed`, and the German text for invalid tool input.
howTo: Nothing to change for a German UI. Tests or log checks that assert on `AI request failed` in a `de*` chat now see the German text. Override single texts with the `streamErrorTexts` handler option (`generic`, `invalidToolInput`).
